video.body: Watch how a memorial can hold a life story, family tree, map, gallery, and messages in one simple page.

items.question: Can I create a memorial for someone in my family?
items.answer: Yes. Create an account, add the person’s story, and only share information you are allowed to publish.

items.question: Can I edit the memorial after publishing?
items.answer: Yes. Owners and invited editors can update text, media, translations, locations, and visibility from the profile area.

items.question: Are memorials reviewed?
items.answer: Halvaa keeps admin controls for moderation. Content that breaks rules can be edited, deleted, hidden, or connected accounts can be banned.

items.question: Can families share one memorial together?
items.answer: Yes. Owners can invite collaborators, collect guestbook messages, and share the public memorial link when their profile is complete.

metadata.title: Halvaa - Where Memories Live Forever
metadata.description: Halvaa is a space to honor those who've passed, share memories, and keep their legacy alive.

landingStory.title: A living record, shaped with care

paragraphs.0: Halvaa gives every life a place that feels personal, searchable, and lasting.
paragraphs.1: Families can preserve media, timelines, locations, and stories without turning memory into noise.
paragraphs.2: Communities can contribute corrections and context, so each memorial can become more complete over time.
paragraphs.3: The platform is built for dignity: clear authorship, thoughtful moderation, and access across languages.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: Questions, disputes, or takedown requests can be sent to support@halvaa.app.

use.title: Use of Halvaa
use.body1: Halvaa provides tools for creating, preserving, discovering, and contributing to memorial pages. You agree to use the service respectfully and lawfully.
use.body2: You are responsible for the content you submit, including memorial text, media, guestbook messages, corrections, and profile details.

content.title: Memorial Content
content.body1: Memorial pages may include family-submitted information, public records, contributor suggestions, and administrator-curated data. Content should be accurate, dignified, and relevant to the person remembered.
content.body2: We may review, moderate, edit, reject, or remove content that is abusive, misleading, private without permission, unlawful, spammy, or inconsistent with the purpose of remembrance.

accounts.title: Accounts and Security
accounts.body1: You must keep your login credentials and verification codes secure. OTP codes are time-limited and should not be shared.
accounts.body2: We may rate-limit, suspend, or restrict accounts that abuse authentication, uploads, guestbook messages, or contribution workflows.

purchases.title: Purchases and Upgrades
purchases.body1: Paid features, credits, featured placements, custom memorial IDs, and theme upgrades may be subject to availability, review, and payment-provider rules.
purchases.body2: Unless required by law, completed digital purchases may be non-refundable after the feature has been assigned or used.

collect.title: Information We Collect
collect.body1: We collect account information such as email, phone number when provided, locale, authentication records, and profile details needed to operate the service.
collect.body2: Memorial data may include names, dates, locations, biographies, media, family history, timeline events, guestbook messages, and contributor suggestions.

use.title: How We Use Information
use.body1: We use data to provide memorial pages, authentication, moderation, search, discovery, collaboration, customer support, security, and service improvement.
use.body2: OTP delivery may use email or SMS providers. Delivery logs may be kept for security, rate limiting, and troubleshooting.

public.title: Public Memorials
public.body1: Published memorial pages are intended to be discoverable and may be visible to visitors, search features, and public landing sections.
public.body2: Private drafts, pending content, and moderation queues are restricted to authorized users and administrators.

retention.title: Retention and Removal
retention.body1: We retain account, memorial, moderation, payment, and security records as needed to provide the service and comply with legal obligations.
retention.body2: Families, authorized collaborators, or affected parties may request correction, removal, or review by contacting support@halvaa.app.

security.title: Security
security.body: We use access controls, rate limits, validation, and review tools to protect the service. No internet service can guarantee absolute security.

operator.title: Operator
operator.body: Halvaa is operated as a memorial and legacy platform. Formal company, mailing, and jurisdiction details should be completed before public commercial launch.

ownership.title: Content Ownership
ownership.body1: Users and contributors retain rights they hold in submitted content, while granting Halvaa permission to host, display, process, moderate, and distribute that content as needed to operate memorial pages.
ownership.body2: Do not upload media or documents unless you have the right to share them.

takedowns.title: Takedowns and Corrections
takedowns.body: If a memorial includes inaccurate, harmful, private, or unauthorized content, contact support@halvaa.app with the memorial link, your relationship to the person remembered, and the requested action.

advice.title: No Professional Advice
advice.body: Halvaa does not provide legal, medical, religious, estate, or funeral advice. Memorial content is informational and commemorative.

abuse.title: Abuse Reporting
abuse.body: Report impersonation, harassment, spam, privacy violations, or unlawful content to support@halvaa.app.
